description: This "figure group" contains no scientific panel at all. It is a single square publisher badge: a rounded-corner tile with a pale grey-to-white vertical gradient background, centred on which is a circular open ring formed by two thick arc segments — an upper/right light-blue arc and a lower/left yellow arc — that do not close into a full circle. Inside the ring sits a solid dark-red, downward-pointing bookmark/ribbon shape (a rectangle with a notched V at its bottom edge). Beneath the graphic, two lines of dark grey sans-serif text read "Check for" on the first line and "updates" on the second, the words broken exactly that way. This is the standard Crossref "Check for updates" logo marking that the article's DOI record can be queried for post-publication corrections; it functions as a hyperlink icon, not as data. There are no axes, units, scale bars, legends, spectra, micrographs, curves or tables, and nothing relating to Fe-Mn-Al-C-(Ni) low-density steel, cold rolling, κ-carbide/B2 precipitation, hardness or tensile response. The figure carries zero scientific information and must not be mined for any material, processing or property value.

observations.observation: The only image in this group is the Crossref 'Check for updates' badge; no scientific panel (micrograph, spectrum, curve, map, table or schematic of the material) is present.
The badge consists of a two-segment circular ring (light-blue and yellow arcs), a dark-red downward-pointing bookmark/ribbon shape at the centre, and the two-line text 'Check for updates'.
The text is set as 'Check for' / 'updates', i.e. the phrase is line-broken after the word 'for'.
The image contains no axes, tick labels, units, scale bars, colour-scale bars, legends or printed numeric values of any kind.

Nothing visible in the image connects to the paper topic (Fe-Mn-Al-C-(Ni) austenitic low-density steel, cold rolling, 973-1173 K heat treatment, κ-carbide/B2 precipitation, hardness, tensile response); the badge is publisher boilerplate.
The figure has no caption in the supplied material, consistent with it being a journal-issued metadata badge rather than an authored figure.

subfigures.description: A square rounded-corner icon with a light grey gradient background showing the Crossref 'Check for updates' badge: a broken circular ring of a light-blue upper-right arc and a yellow lower-left arc around a dark-red downward bookmark/ribbon shape, with the two-line text 'Check for / updates' below.

unreadable_items: No scientific content exists in this image: there is no panel to read, so no material, processing condition, phase or property value can be extracted.
The image provides no evidence about any figure of the paper; any downstream claim tying this badge to Fe-Mn-Al-C-(Ni) low-density steel would be unfounded.
